rules.action: require documented level shifting or mark PENDIENTE_DE_VERIFICAR

rules.when: wiring uses a board pin marked reserved or boot_sensitive
rules.action: warn and require explicit project decision

rules.when: two project connections use the same board pin without a shared-bus declaration
two instances on the same bus use the same address without a mux or configuration
voltage, current, isolation, range or tolerance depends on a module variant
rules.action: mark the field PENDIENTE_DE_VERIFICAR and require model/source
